1: // Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors
2: // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3: const grpc = require('@grpc/grpc-js')
4: const protoLoader = require('@grpc/proto-loader')
5: const health = require('grpc-js-health-check')
6: const opentelemetry = require('@opentelemetry/api')
7: const { ATTR_ERROR_TYPE } = require('@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions')
8: 
9: const charge = require('./charge')
10: const logger = require('./logger')
11: 
12: async function chargeServiceHandler(call, callback) {
13:   const span = opentelemetry.trace.getActiveSpan();
14: 
15:   try {
16:     const amount = call.request.amount
17:     span?.setAttributes({
18:       'demo.payment.amount': (Number(amount.units) + amount.nanos / 1000000000).toFixed(2)
19:     })
20:     logger.info("Charge request received.")
21: 
22:     const response = await charge.charge(call.request)
23:     callback(null, response)
24: 
25:   } catch (err) {
26:     logger.warn({ err })
27: 
28:     span?.setStatus({ code: opentelemetry.SpanStatusCode.ERROR, message: err.message })
29:     span?.setAttribute(ATTR_ERROR_TYPE, err.name || 'Error')
30:     callback(err)
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: async function closeGracefully(signal) {
35:   server.forceShutdown()
36:   process.kill(process.pid, signal)
37: }
38: 
39: const otelDemoPackage = grpc.loadPackageDefinition(protoLoader.loadSync('demo.proto'))
40: const server = new grpc.Server()
41: 
42: server.addService(health.service, new health.Implementation({
43:   '': health.servingStatus.SERVING
44: }))
45: 
46: server.addService(otelDemoPackage.oteldemo.PaymentService.service, { charge: chargeServiceHandler })
47: 
48: 
49: let ip = "0.0.0.0";
50: 
51: const ipv6_enabled = process.env.IPV6_ENABLED;
52: 
53: if (ipv6_enabled == "true") {
54:   ip = "[::]";
55:   logger.info(`Overwriting Localhost IP: ${ip}`)
56: }
57: 
58: const address = ip + `:${process.env['PAYMENT_PORT']}`;
59: 
60: server.bindAsync(address, grpc.ServerCredentials.createInsecure(), (err, port) => {
61:   if (err) {
62:     return logger.error({ err })
63:   }
64: 
65:   server.start()
66:   logger.info(`payment gRPC server started on ${address}`)
67: })
68: 
69: process.once('SIGINT', closeGracefully)
70: process.once('SIGTERM', closeGracefully)

3: const grpc = require('@grpc/grpc-js')
4: const protoLoader = require('@grpc/proto-loader')
5: const health = require('grpc-js-health-check')
6: const opentelemetry = require('@opentelemetry/api')
7: const { ATTR_ERROR_TYPE } = require('@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions')
8: 
9: const charge = require('./charge')
10: const logger = require('./logger')
11: 
12: async function chargeServiceHandler(call, callback) {
13:   const span = opentelemetry.trace.getActiveSpan();
14: 
15:   try {
16:     const amount = call.request.amount
17:     span?.setAttributes({
18:       'demo.payment.amount': (Number(amount.units) + amount.nanos / 1000000000).toFixed(2)
19:     })
20:     logger.info("Charge request received.")
21: 
22:     const response = await charge.charge(call.request)
23:     callback(null, response)
24: 
25:   } catch (err) {
26:     logger.warn({ err })
27: 
28:     span?.setStatus({ code: opentelemetry.SpanStatusCode.ERROR, message: err.message })
29:     span?.setAttribute(ATTR_ERROR_TYPE, err.name || 'Error')
30:     callback(err)
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: async function closeGracefully(signal) {
35:   server.forceShutdown()
36:   process.kill(process.pid, signal)
37: }
38: 
39: const otelDemoPackage = grpc.loadPackageDefinition(protoLoader.loadSync('demo.proto'))
40: const server = new grpc.Server()
41: 
42: server.addService(health.service, new health.Implementation({
43:   '': health.servingStatus.SERVING
44: }))
45: 
46: server.addService(otelDemoPackage.oteldemo.PaymentService.service, { charge: chargeServiceHandler })
47: 
48: 
49: let ip = "0.0.0.0";
50: 
51: const ipv6_enabled = process.env.IPV6_ENABLED;
52: 
53: if (ipv6_enabled == "true") {
54:   ip = "[::]";
55:   logger.info(`Overwriting Localhost IP: ${ip}`)
56: }
57: 
58: const address = ip + `:${process.env['PAYMENT_PORT']}`;
59: 
60: server.bindAsync(address, grpc.ServerCredentials.createInsecure(), (err, port) => {
61:   if (err) {
62:     return logger.error({ err })
63:   }
64: 
65:   server.start()
66:   logger.info(`payment gRPC server started on ${address}`)
67: })
68: 
69: process.once('SIGINT', closeGracefully)
70: process.once('SIGTERM', closeGracefully)

1: // Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors
2: // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3: const grpc = require('@grpc/grpc-js')
4: const protoLoader = require('@grpc/proto-loader')
5: const health = require('grpc-js-health-check')
6: const opentelemetry = require('@opentelemetry/api')
7: const { ATTR_ERROR_TYPE } = require('@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions')
8: 
9: const charge = require('./charge')
10: const logger = require('./logger')
11: 
12: async function chargeServiceHandler(call, callback) {
13:   const span = opentelemetry.trace.getActiveSpan();
14: 
15:   try {
16:     const amount = call.request.amount
17:     span?.setAttributes({
18:       'demo.payment.amount': (Number(amount.units) + amount.nanos / 1000000000).toFixed(2)
19:     })
20:     logger.info("Charge request received.")
21: 
22:     const response = await charge.charge(call.request)
23:     callback(null, response)
24: 
25:   } catch (err) {
26:     logger.warn({ err })
27: 
28:     span?.setStatus({ code: opentelemetry.SpanStatusCode.ERROR, message: err.message })
29:     span?.setAttribute(ATTR_ERROR_TYPE, err.name || 'Error')
30:     callback(err)
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: async function closeGracefully(signal) {
35:   server.forceShutdown()
36:   process.kill(process.pid, signal)
37: }
38: 
39: const otelDemoPackage = grpc.loadPackageDefinition(protoLoader.loadSync('demo.proto'))
40: const server = new grpc.Server()
41: 
42: server.addService(health.service, new health.Implementation({
43:   '': health.servingStatus.SERVING
44: }))
45: 
46: server.addService(otelDemoPackage.oteldemo.PaymentService.service, { charge: chargeServiceHandler })
47: 
48: 
49: let ip = "0.0.0.0";
50: 
51: const ipv6_enabled = process.env.IPV6_ENABLED;
52: 
53: if (ipv6_enabled == "true") {
54:   ip = "[::]";
55:   logger.info(`Overwriting Localhost IP: ${ip}`)
56: }
57: 
58: const address = ip + `:${process.env['PAYMENT_PORT']}`;
59: 
60: server.bindAsync(address, grpc.ServerCredentials.createInsecure(), (err, port) => {
61:   if (err) {
62:     return logger.error({ err })
63:   }
64: 
65:   server.start()
66:   logger.info(`payment gRPC server started on ${address}`)
67: })
68: 
69: process.once('SIGINT', closeGracefully)
70: process.once('SIGTERM', closeGracefully)

1: // Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors
2: // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3: const grpc = require('@grpc/grpc-js')
4: const protoLoader = require('@grpc/proto-loader')
5: const health = require('grpc-js-health-check')
6: const opentelemetry = require('@opentelemetry/api')
7: const { ATTR_ERROR_TYPE } = require('@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions')
8: 
9: const charge = require('./charge')
10: const logger = require('./logger')
11: 
12: async function chargeServiceHandler(call, callback) {
13:   const span = opentelemetry.trace.getActiveSpan();
14: 
15:   try {
16:     const amount = call.request.amount
17:     span?.setAttributes({
18:       'demo.payment.amount': (Number(amount.units) + amount.nanos / 1000000000).toFixed(2)
19:     })
20:     logger.info("Charge request received.")
21: 
22:     const response = await charge.charge(call.request)
23:     callback(null, response)
24: 
25:   } catch (err) {
26:     logger.warn({ err })
27: 
28:     span?.setStatus({ code: opentelemetry.SpanStatusCode.ERROR, message: err.message })
29:     span?.setAttribute(ATTR_ERROR_TYPE, err.name || 'Error')
30:     callback(err)
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: async function closeGracefully(signal) {
35:   server.forceShutdown()
36:   process.kill(process.pid, signal)
37: }
38: 
39: const otelDemoPackage = grpc.loadPackageDefinition(protoLoader.loadSync('demo.proto'))
40: const server = new grpc.Server()
41: 
42: server.addService(health.service, new health.Implementation({
43:   '': health.servingStatus.SERVING
44: }))
45: 
46: server.addService(otelDemoPackage.oteldemo.PaymentService.service, { charge: chargeServiceHandler })
47: 
48: 
49: let ip = "0.0.0.0";
50: 
51: const ipv6_enabled = process.env.IPV6_ENABLED;
52: 
53: if (ipv6_enabled == "true") {
54:   ip = "[::]";
55:   logger.info(`Overwriting Localhost IP: ${ip}`)
56: }
57: 
58: const address = ip + `:${process.env['PAYMENT_PORT']}`;
59: 
60: server.bindAsync(address, grpc.ServerCredentials.createInsecure(), (err, port) => {
61:   if (err) {
62:     return logger.error({ err })
63:   }
64: 
65:   server.start()
66:   logger.info(`payment gRPC server started on ${address}`)
67: })
68: 
69: process.once('SIGINT', closeGracefully)
70: process.once('SIGTERM', closeGracefully)

diagnosis.root_cause: EmptyCart failures are most consistent with the cartFailure failure-injection path selecting the bad cart store, where Redis/Valkey connectivity fails. The strongest observation is an EmptyCart log and a Redis connection error carrying the same trace ID (ev_003). The handler source confirms that a positive cartFailure rate routes EmptyCart to _badCartStore, while the current runtime snapshot reports cartFailure's default variant as 100% (ev_006, ev_007). Successful GetCart/AddItem operations against valkey-cart in sampled incident traces weaken the hypothesis of a broad outage but do not prove the bad store's endpoint or historical flag evaluation.
diagnosis.recommended_remediation: For human review, temporarily and reversibly set the cartFailure flag to its off/0% variant, then verify EmptyCart error rate and Redis connectivity. If failures persist, inspect the bad-store Redis endpoint and connection events; do not assume the current flag snapshot proves what was evaluated during the incident.
limitations: The runtime configuration read is a current mounted snapshot, not historical state or proof of effective flag evaluation.
The traces are bounded and sampled; successful operations do not establish that every Redis endpoint or EmptyCart request succeeded.

result.reason: The incident and baseline metrics show a large latency regression, while incident logs directly report an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on catalog.products. Source confirms a feature-controlled lock-contention loop in product-catalog; this is a stronger causal explanation than the observed NOT_FOUND responses or an unshown remote dependency.

diagnosis.root_cause: Product-catalog database reads were delayed by ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock contention on catalog.products. Incident logs explicitly report the lock-contention scenario, and the service source contains a recurring feature-controlled lock trigger. The server p95 increased from 327 ms in baseline to 15,000 ms during the incident, consistent with blocked reads. The NOT_FOUND spans are an observed secondary/error pattern, but current configuration is not historical proof that the failure flag caused the incident.
diagnosis.recommended_remediation: With human review, disable/revert the productCatalogLockContention scenario to its safe off variant, then verify database lock release and product-catalog latency/error rates. Avoid restarting or rolling back until lock state and flag evaluation are checked; the current configuration snapshot is not proof of historical activation.
limitations: The runtime configuration is a current mounted snapshot and does not establish historical flag evaluation.
The source is a pinned snapshot and does not prove the deployed image is identical.
Trace and metric data have bounded coverage, export delay, and sampling limitations.
The evidence establishes lock contention in logs but does not directly expose database lock-holder identity or confirm lock release after mitigation.

diagnosis.root_cause: Checkout's payment client is selecting the deliberately invalid endpoint `badAddress:50051`, causing the observed gRPC `Unavailable` error `name resolver error: produced zero addresses`. This is consistent with the checkout source, which replaces the normal payment client when `PaymentUnreachable` evaluates true (ev_005), and with the current runtime snapshot showing `paymentUnreachable` defaulting to `on` (ev_006). Incident traces directly show checkout's `PaymentService/Charge` failing at the client with that resolver error and no payment service spans (ev_003); checkout requests consequently return errors, while incident logs confirm repeated PlaceOrder activity (ev_007). result.reason: Incident traces directly show checkout's PaymentService/Charge failing before any payment-service span with gRPC name-resolver 'produced zero addresses'; checkout metrics show all observed server calls errored. The current runtime snapshot and pinned checkout source provide a plausible, reversible mechanism: PaymentUnreachable routes checkout to badAddress:50051. This distinguishes a checkout-side destination fault from a payment-service rejection, while noting that the configuration snapshot is not historical proof of flag evaluation.

diagnosis.root_cause: Checkout is failing to resolve its payment destination: incident traces show checkout's client PaymentService/Charge spans returning UNAVAILABLE with 'name resolver error: produced zero addresses,' while no payment-service traces appear in the incident window. The current runtime snapshot has PaymentUnreachable enabled with default variant 'on', and the pinned checkout code shows that this flag replaces the normal payment client with badAddress:50051. Together these support an injected or otherwise checkout-side invalid destination as the root cause, rather than a payment-service card-charge failure. The snapshot is current and does not prove the flag's historical evaluation, so that part remains an inference.
diagnosis.recommended_remediation: Request human review and, if the incident change is confirmed, revert the PaymentUnreachable flag to its off variant (or restore the normal payment destination), then verify that checkout charge spans reach payment and succeed. This is a minimal, reversible configuration change; do not restart or modify payment until post-change evidence indicates a payment-side fault.
limitations: The runtime configuration is a current snapshot, not historical activation or proof of effective evaluation during the incident.
The pinned source snapshot is not proof that the deployed checkout image has identical contents.
Trace and metric data are bounded/span-derived and may be incomplete, although the repeated resolver errors are explicit.

result.reason: Incident traces show checkout's Charge client failing immediately with a resolver error before any payment-server span, while checkout errors are elevated and payment has no observed server calls. The current flag snapshot and pinned checkout source provide a matching mechanism, though neither proves historical flag evaluation or deployed-image identity.

diagnosis.root_cause: Checkout's payment call is being redirected to an invalid endpoint by the PaymentUnreachable feature path. In the incident traces, checkout's client Charge spans fail with gRPC UNAVAILABLE and "name resolver error: produced zero addresses," and no payment server requests are observed; checkout has 12 incident errors while payment reports zero server calls. The current runtime snapshot has PaymentUnreachable defaulting to "on", and the pinned checkout source shows that this path constructs "badAddress:50051". The configuration snapshot is current rather than historical, and the source is not proof of the deployed image, so those details establish a strongly corroborated mechanism rather than direct proof of evaluation at incident time.
diagnosis.recommended_remediation: Request human review and a reversible configuration change to set PaymentUnreachable to its off variant for checkout, then verify new checkout Charge traces reach the payment server and error counts recover. Do not alter payment service state or restart pods unless post-change evidence indicates it is necessary.
limitations: The runtime configuration read is a current mounted snapshot and does not prove historical flag evaluation.
The pinned source snapshot does not prove the deployed checkout image contents.
Trace and metric telemetry may have sampling, export delay, or incomplete coverage; payment's zero observed calls is not proof that it received no traffic outside telemetry.

decisions.reason: Establish whether checkout failures and latency changed during the incident, and compare that with the known symptom that payment is available. This is the most direct first read for distinguishing a checkout-local failure from a downstream payment outage.

1: // Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors
2: // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3: const grpc = require('@grpc/grpc-js')
4: const protoLoader = require('@grpc/proto-loader')
5: const health = require('grpc-js-health-check')
6: const opentelemetry = require('@opentelemetry/api')
7: const { ATTR_ERROR_TYPE } = require('@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions')
8: 
9: const charge = require('./charge')
10: const logger = require('./logger')
11: 
12: async function chargeServiceHandler(call, callback) {
13:   const span = opentelemetry.trace.getActiveSpan();
14: 
15:   try {
16:     const amount = call.request.amount
17:     span?.setAttributes({
18:       'demo.payment.amount': (Number(amount.units) + amount.nanos / 1000000000).toFixed(2)
19:     })
20:     logger.info("Charge request received.")
21: 
22:     const response = await charge.charge(call.request)
23:     callback(null, response)
24: 
25:   } catch (err) {
26:     logger.warn({ err })
27: 
28:     span?.setStatus({ code: opentelemetry.SpanStatusCode.ERROR, message: err.message })
29:     span?.setAttribute(ATTR_ERROR_TYPE, err.name || 'Error')
30:     callback(err)
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: async function closeGracefully(signal) {
35:   server.forceShutdown()
36:   process.kill(process.pid, signal)
37: }
38: 
39: const otelDemoPackage = grpc.loadPackageDefinition(protoLoader.loadSync('demo.proto'))
40: const server = new grpc.Server()
41: 
42: server.addService(health.service, new health.Implementation({
43:   '': health.servingStatus.SERVING
44: }))
45: 
46: server.addService(otelDemoPackage.oteldemo.PaymentService.service, { charge: chargeServiceHandler })
47: 
48: 
49: let ip = "0.0.0.0";
50: 
51: const ipv6_enabled = process.env.IPV6_ENABLED;
52: 
53: if (ipv6_enabled == "true") {
54:   ip = "[::]";
55:   logger.info(`Overwriting Localhost IP: ${ip}`)
56: }
57: 
58: const address = ip + `:${process.env['PAYMENT_PORT']}`;
59: 
60: server.bindAsync(address, grpc.ServerCredentials.createInsecure(), (err, port) => {
61:   if (err) {
62:     return logger.error({ err })
63:   }
64: 
65:   server.start()
66:   logger.info(`payment gRPC server started on ${address}`)
67: })
68: 
69: process.once('SIGINT', closeGracefully)
70: process.once('SIGTERM', closeGracefully)

3: const grpc = require('@grpc/grpc-js')
4: const protoLoader = require('@grpc/proto-loader')
5: const health = require('grpc-js-health-check')
6: const opentelemetry = require('@opentelemetry/api')
7: const { ATTR_ERROR_TYPE } = require('@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions')
8: 
9: const charge = require('./charge')
10: const logger = require('./logger')
11: 
12: async function chargeServiceHandler(call, callback) {
13:   const span = opentelemetry.trace.getActiveSpan();
14: 
15:   try {
16:     const amount = call.request.amount
17:     span?.setAttributes({
18:       'demo.payment.amount': (Number(amount.units) + amount.nanos / 1000000000).toFixed(2)
19:     })
20:     logger.info("Charge request received.")
21: 
22:     const response = await charge.charge(call.request)
23:     callback(null, response)
24: 
25:   } catch (err) {
26:     logger.warn({ err })
27: 
28:     span?.setStatus({ code: opentelemetry.SpanStatusCode.ERROR, message: err.message })
29:     span?.setAttribute(ATTR_ERROR_TYPE, err.name || 'Error')
30:     callback(err)
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: async function closeGracefully(signal) {
35:   server.forceShutdown()
36:   process.kill(process.pid, signal)
37: }
38: 
39: const otelDemoPackage = grpc.loadPackageDefinition(protoLoader.loadSync('demo.proto'))
40: const server = new grpc.Server()
41: 
42: server.addService(health.service, new health.Implementation({
43:   '': health.servingStatus.SERVING
44: }))
45: 
46: server.addService(otelDemoPackage.oteldemo.PaymentService.service, { charge: chargeServiceHandler })
47: 
48: 
49: let ip = "0.0.0.0";
50: 
51: const ipv6_enabled = process.env.IPV6_ENABLED;
52: 
53: if (ipv6_enabled == "true") {
54:   ip = "[::]";
55:   logger.info(`Overwriting Localhost IP: ${ip}`)
56: }
57: 
58: const address = ip + `:${process.env['PAYMENT_PORT']}`;

1: // Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors
2: // SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
3: const grpc = require('@grpc/grpc-js')
4: const protoLoader = require('@grpc/proto-loader')
5: const health = require('grpc-js-health-check')
6: const opentelemetry = require('@opentelemetry/api')
7: const { ATTR_ERROR_TYPE } = require('@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions')
8: 
9: const charge = require('./charge')
10: const logger = require('./logger')
11: 
12: async function chargeServiceHandler(call, callback) {
13:   const span = opentelemetry.trace.getActiveSpan();
14: 
15:   try {
16:     const amount = call.request.amount
17:     span?.setAttributes({
18:       'demo.payment.amount': (Number(amount.units) + amount.nanos / 1000000000).toFixed(2)
19:     })
20:     logger.info("Charge request received.")
21: 
22:     const response = await charge.charge(call.request)
23:     callback(null, response)
24: 
25:   } catch (err) {
26:     logger.warn({ err })
27: 
28:     span?.setStatus({ code: opentelemetry.SpanStatusCode.ERROR, message: err.message })
29:     span?.setAttribute(ATTR_ERROR_TYPE, err.name || 'Error')
30:     callback(err)
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: async function closeGracefully(signal) {
35:   server.forceShutdown()
36:   process.kill(process.pid, signal)
37: }
38: 
39: const otelDemoPackage = grpc.loadPackageDefinition(protoLoader.loadSync('demo.proto'))
40: const server = new grpc.Server()
41: 
42: server.addService(health.service, new health.Implementation({
43:   '': health.servingStatus.SERVING
44: }))
45: 
46: server.addService(otelDemoPackage.oteldemo.PaymentService.service, { charge: chargeServiceHandler })
47: 
48: 
49: let ip = "0.0.0.0";
50: 
51: const ipv6_enabled = process.env.IPV6_ENABLED;
52: 
53: if (ipv6_enabled == "true") {
54:   ip = "[::]";
55:   logger.info(`Overwriting Localhost IP: ${ip}`)
56: }
57: 
58: const address = ip + `:${process.env['PAYMENT_PORT']}`;
59: 
60: server.bindAsync(address, grpc.ServerCredentials.createInsecure(), (err, port) => {
61:   if (err) {
62:     return logger.error({ err })
63:   }
64: 
65:   server.start()
66:   logger.info(`payment gRPC server started on ${address}`)
67: })
68: 
69: process.once('SIGINT', closeGracefully)
70: process.once('SIGTERM', closeGracefully)
